description: Understand the work before you automate it. Revensi helps you explore workflow maps, open questions, and supporting context in one place. Use a guided conversation to map a new process, capture its key steps and decisions, and save a draft for review. Give your team a clearer picture of how work happens and what an AI system needs to support.
